# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia milestone m148. It adds variable and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and refreshed native dependencies. This is a breaking release for anyone relying on legacy null-typeface behavior — review the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the type no longer implements IEquatable<T> or the == / != operators. Update any code that compares two GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo instances with Equals or operators to compare fields directly instead.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is now get-only** — The protected IgnorePublicDispose property lost its setter. Derived types that assigned it directly must instead set it through the constructor or another provided mechanism.
- **SKFont/SKPaint no longer resolve a null typeface lazily** — new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you assign a real typeface; new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, and use Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check to detect "unset". ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and Default are now never null** — FromFamilyName("missing") now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform, including Android (previously null there), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere. For a strict "was it found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The overload used to silently truncate offsets larger than int.MaxValue; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m148** — Bundles the Chrome m148 engine, rolling up the m132/m147 upgrades from the preview cycle along with upstream bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support, with improved variable font robustness. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP and zero-copy stream data** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSurface/SKCanvas sampling options** — Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and a HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Fixed API naming and wrapper gaps** — Adds missing API wrappers and fixes naming convention violations found while auditing the surface. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Corrected pixel access strides and offsets** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload uses Height instead of Width when computing its offset. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **Fixed a path finalizer crash** — SKPath no longer crashes when its SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Restored default-typeface resolution and WinUI packaging** — Moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Fixed MAUI and sample regressions** — SKGLView now renders correctly after a MAUI TabBar tab switch, and the Uno gallery sample no longer downgrades the Skottie package. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3785](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3785))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reworked singleton lifecycle** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a [ModuleInitializer] to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))
- **Legacy text APIs promoted to compile errors** — Obsolete legacy paint text/font state-reading APIs and the remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors, completing the v3-to-v4 API cleanup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Platform

- **Broader native platform support** — Adds Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native build support, and uses PolySharp to enable C# 13 language features on legacy target frameworks. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642))

## Security

- **Refreshed bundled native dependencies** — Updates expat, freetype, zlib, libjpeg-turbo and libpng/libexpat to their latest versions, and updates harfbuzz to 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0 and adds variable font shaping support alongside the HBColor struct for hb_color_t representation.
